title: FSM-Bench-20: Local LLM Benchmark for Deterministic FSM Generation
description: Reproducible benchmark of 20 natural-language requirement specifications for evaluating open-weight LLMs on guarded finite-state machine generation under local Ollama inference. GitHub tag v1.1.0 is the public replication package for the IST revision (dataset, prompt specification, schema, evaluator, guard-aware M0–M3, criterion freeze, unit tests, campaign manifests, aggregate metrics summaries, and per-group diagnostics for manifest 20260602T195520Z). Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20517969 archives GitHub release v1.0.0 and does not contain the guard-aware revision files. Full per-pair CSV records and raw/cleaned model outputs are size-excluded from the public archive.
